device_entry.description: 通用 MQTT 客户端组件，用于通过 MQTT 代理发布设备状态、订阅控制主题，并支持 Home Assistant 自动发现配置。它常用于将实验室设备、传感器或执行器接入消息总线，实现远程监控与集成。
device_entry.description_en: A generic MQTT client component used to publish device states, subscribe to control topics, and support Home Assistant discovery configuration through an MQTT broker. It is commonly used to connect lab equipment, sensors, or actuators to a message bus for remote monitoring and integration.
